description: Integrate notification-hub with vrooli-events for event-driven notifications. Notification-hub subscribes to vrooli-events SSE stream. User-configurable subscription rules using glob patterns (e.g. swarm-manager.backlog.* to get notified on all backlog events, or swarm-manager.backlog.item-completed.v1 for specific events). Map event subscriptions to notification templates and delivery channels. Priority mapping from event metadata to notification priority. This enables 'get notified when a backlog item completes' or 'get notified when any scenario needs attention' without modifying the source scenarios. Subscription management via notification-hub API, CLI, and UI.
name: notification-hub-event-subscriptions
title: Wire Notification Hub To vrooli-events Subscriptions
